stable_onset_definition: Earliest recorded checkpoint at which emergence holds and remains true at every later recorded checkpoint.

frozen_endpoints.E01_parameter_match: All D=1,2,3,4,6,8 primary models have trainable parameter counts within 5 percent of 2480.
frozen_endpoints.E02_dim1_no_edge: At most 1 of 12 D=1 trajectories has stable onset by 2400 updates.
frozen_endpoints.E03_dim2_eventual: At least 18 of 24 D=2 trajectories have stable onset by 1400 updates.
frozen_endpoints.E04_dim3_eventual: At least 20 of 24 D=3 trajectories have stable onset by 1000 updates.
frozen_endpoints.E05_dim4_eventual: At least 20 of 24 D=4 trajectories have stable onset by 800 updates.
frozen_endpoints.E06_overcomplete_eventual: At least one of D=6 or D=8 has at least 20 of 24 stable onsets by 800 updates.
frozen_endpoints.E07_dimension_acceleration: Median stable onset for D=4 is no more than 80 percent of the D=2 median.
frozen_endpoints.E08_sustained_behavior: At least 95 percent of trajectories with any hit have no later relapse after their stable onset, by construction, and fewer than 10 percent have more than one relapse after first hit.
frozen_endpoints.E09_cut_specificity: Mean cut accuracy among emerged checkpoints is at most 0.10 in every D>=2 configuration.
frozen_endpoints.E10_causal_synchrony: For at least 90 percent of successful primary trajectories, first task, probe, and patch threshold crossings occur within 150 updates of one another.
frozen_endpoints.E11_edge_model_discrimination: Leave-one-seed-out or bootstrap out-of-sample AUC of the fitted edge model is at least 0.85.
frozen_endpoints.E12_geometry_warning: Minimum second-to-first latent singular-value ratio predicts stable emergence with AUC at least 0.80 before the stable-onset checkpoint.
frozen_endpoints.E13_crossed_variance: The crossed D=2 diagnostic produces a finite decomposition of onset variability into initialization, data-stream, and residual components; no directional dominance threshold is preregistered.
frozen_endpoints.E14_all_receipts: Every result file reports no intermediate workspace labels, no valence model, and no self-preservation reward.
